notes.title: The AI is ready!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/8cb5674ab52f40511b1e3d0860fa50a015c2e47b.jpg[/img]

Dear Foosball Gladiators,

Today we are more than happy to release our Koliseum Soccer with AI bots.

Now, [b]with the AI bots, you can start playing real matches[/b]. It’s finaly time to perform the unique features of our game, naming the dribble, the lob and the basic shoot you've been training, on the practice mode, these last weeks.  

[h1]Our AI bots have 5 levels of increasing difficulty:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Beginner:[/b]  [i]We all started... one day[/i]
[*] [b]Regular:[/b]   [i]It’s a good base[/i]
[*] [b]Expert:[/b]  [i]Sounds like you learned how to play[/i]
[*] [b]Master:[/b]  [i]Wow... you’re damn good ![/i]
[*] [b]Shaolin:[/b]  [i]Are you serious?[/i]
[/list]

You can choose to play [b]1 vs 1[/b] [img][/img][u]or[/u] [b]2 vs 2.[/b] So, give it a try and master it before changing levels.

BTW, we’ll be pleased to have your feedback about the levels of our AI bots, to adjust  them accordingly (contact@kynoa.com).

The next big feature is going to be multiplayer online. Stay tuned.

Kynoa Team

[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/d06a26cb9434c4c1bec151a1f356d6f27884b09c.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/11b190e9c2db0f35c664a301583cc43b2325ab95.jpg[/img][/url]  [url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/23733f3496856d631697ecbf369b1bfc8eeac6ff.jpg][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/e50373ac4c3290189da97d1e8256a7736043b7a0.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: About the Practice Mode
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33705937/df93ac3a766e48c21fce949d209039a9e10741ff.jpg[/img]

Dear all,

Since we started, our tutorial was explaining the few different tricks we implemented in our game.  Thanks to your feedback we decided to add a practice mode, so you can train these new tricks. So, here is a preview of the practice mode we released a couple of days ago .   

[h1] Here are the 3 practice mode:[/h1]
[list][*] [b]the Shoot[/b] - 4 levels - from a single target to shoot at, to a moving target behind moving silhouettes.
[*][b] the Dribble[/b] - 4 levels - from a simple grab to a long dribble avoiding moving silhouettes to finnaly hit a moving target
[*] [b]the Lobe[/b] - from a simple little lobe to a very long one (the goalkeeper must score by shooting above several rows of silhouettes)
[/list]

These changes are live since a few days!

Enjoy, and thanks again for all your constructive feedback around the game!

Kynoa team
